semantics.scope: Retrospective phase analysis. No robot execution, code/config change, or raw-log edits.
semantics.cohort: Matched morning six runs, two per controller; final completed video takes independently reported. Camera retakes are not marked invalid.
semantics.estimator: Joint+IMU reconstruction, 200 Hz, 105 ms third-order SG; same estimator across controllers. 75/135 ms sensitivity retained.
semantics.phases: Nominal command schedule: start [5,7), middle [7,15), stop-settle [15,18). Stage entries checked within 10 ms. Stop is not guaranteed stationary throughout.
semantics.union: Start+stop selects the union of time samples, duration weighted 2:3; derivatives computed before masking. One mean axis/mean relative velocity across union.
semantics.swing: RMS angular distance from endpoint +Z to its normalized mean direction per run and selected window; union includes between-phase mean shifts.
semantics.velocity: 3D endpoint-minus-torso-IMU velocity in fixed H0, demeaned per window; not absolute world speed.
semantics.statistics: Each run computed independently, then equal-weight arithmetic mean across runs; no significance claim.
semantics.hold: hold_current ablates learned prediction only; current IMU, gravity, and moving-base dynamics retained.
